title: Dispatch: Replace invalid position sentinels in CLI tests (attempt 4)
description:
Dispatch of eshyra-jhpt.3 (attempt 4) — final fix before this work goes to PR.

Attempt 3 (74f28bd) is ACCEPTED: every position-taking store entry point now parses and canonicalizes via parseCampaignPosition and rejects a malformed value with CampaignRuleError, with a negative test covering all three entry points. Keep it.

WORKTREE / BRANCH
.worktrees/eshyra-jhpt.3.4 on branch eshyra-jhpt.3.4, cut from 74f28bd on eshyra-jhpt.3.3. Work only inside that worktree.

*** FIRST, BEFORE ANYTHING ELSE: run `npm ci` in this worktree. ***
This is required by AGENTS.md (Build & Test: "npm ci # CI or worktree install") and it is NOT optional here. A fresh linked worktree has no node_modules, so `@eshyra/core` resolves UP to the parent checkout's copy - which is on main and contains none of this branch's work. Without the install, every packages/cli test silently runs against main's core and reports a false green. That is exactly what hid the defect below through three attempts. After `npm ci`, confirm node_modules/@eshyra/core is a symlink into THIS worktree before you trust any test result. Tracked repo-wide as eshyra-3dmq.

FINDING — three invalid position sentinels remain in the CLI package, and they are real failures.
Attempt 2 introduced `campaignPosition: 'test-position'` across the assembleContext call sites. Attempt 3 replaced them with DEFAULT_TEST_CAMPAIGN_POSITION in packages/core/test/** but MISSED packages/cli/test/play.test.ts, which still has three at lines ~391, ~1297 and ~1310.
These are not cosmetic. Supervisor ran `npm ci` in the attempt-3 worktree, rebuilt, and re-ran that file:
    FAIL packages/cli/test/play.test.ts
    CampaignRuleError: invalid campaign position "test-position"
    Tests  2 failed | 43 passed | 1 skipped (46)
They "passed" only because of the stale-resolution problem above.

FIX
Replace all three with a real canonical position. packages/core/test/support/db.ts already exports DEFAULT_TEST_CAMPAIGN_POSITION built via formatCampaignPosition; if that helper is not importable from the CLI test package, build an equivalent canonical position in play.test.ts using formatCampaignPosition from '@eshyra/core/internal' rather than inventing another placeholder string. Do not weaken the store validation to accept these values, and do not delete the assertions in those tests.

VERIFICATION
`npm ci` first (see above), then `npm run verify:worktree` from the worktree root, BEFORE committing (it rewrites files). In your completion notes, state explicitly that you ran npm ci first and that node_modules/@eshyra/core resolves into this worktree, plus the final pass/skip counts.

SCOPE
Only the three sentinel replacements. Do not change the store, the projection, the rendering, the migration, or the orchestrator.
